title: Geometry, Dynamics, and Topology of the Thickness Landscape: A Morse-Theoretic Analysis of the Return Map in the Class $\mathcal{O}_C$
summary: We study the geometry, dynamics, and topology of the thickness landscape associated with the geometric return map in the class $\mathcal O_C$. For a convex core $C$ and an admissible outer domain $Ω$, the fixed points of the return map $F:\partial C\to\partial C$ coincide with the critical points of the thickness function $d$. At any such critical point $c_*$, the exact linearization reads \[ DF(c_*)=I+B_*H_*, \] where $H_*=\operatorname{Hess}_{\partial C}d(c_*)$ and $B_*=d_*(I-d_*S_*)^{-1}$ is positive definite.
